description: A ground-level photograph depicting an open, flat landscape identified as an exploited peat bog. The foreground and midground show extensive dark brown, bare peat fields, possibly with visible cultivation marks, interspersed with several parallel, linear drainage ditches. One ditch is prominently visible in the mid-right, containing some standing water and sparse aquatic vegetation. In the distant background, a strip of green deciduous trees is visible along the horizon under a bright, overcast sky. The image was taken in 2012 and is attributed to the European Union and LUCAS (Land Use / Cover Area frame Survey).
